description: Aggregated World Bank poverty estimates at the regional/group level (not per-country). Returns headcount, poverty gap, mean welfare, and total population in poverty for each group. group_by controls the aggregation: "wb" = World Bank geographic regions, "inc" = income groups (HIC/UMIC/LMIC/LIC), "none" = global total.

group_by.description: Aggregation: "wb" geographic regions, "inc" income groups, "none" global total. Default "wb".

povline.description: Poverty line in $/day (2017 PPP). Common values: 2.15, 3.65, 6.85. Default 2.15.

name: get_poverty_regional
